# ShapePreset

A named slider vector the panel offers as a button.

## Parameters

- `name`: A string. Preset name (the button caption).
- `sliders`: An array of [ShapeSlider](ShapeSlider.md) objects. Slider values the preset sets; every other slider resets to 0.
- `proportions`: An array of [JointProportion](JointProportion.md) objects. Proportions the preset sets; every other joint resets to identity.
